title: 第1817章 三招之内你不死唐某自裁于此第1816章 各位随我前往仙古战区
slug: 穿书女频大婚当日被女主杀死
content_zh:
镇域峰主开口道：“我古仙院只与叶凌天等人有仇，只要你们脱离天盟，他日我仙族大军过界，你们或许可得一线生机。”
永恒帝尊冷声道：“可笑至极！
仙族嗜杀，喜食生灵血肉，仙古一战，上苍界便有诸多生灵被仙族屠杀、吞噬，今日你们还想妖言惑众？”
“......”
天盟的其余人也是神色淡漠的看着古仙院的众人，到了他们这个境界，谁又是傻子？
他们没有道族、冥土那样的背景，此刻靠拢仙族，他们下场定然会如古仙域的那些生灵一般，变成仙族一员，犹如傀儡一般，身不由己，最终化作炮灰，亦或者变成仙族的血食。
唯有抵抗到底，他们才能有一线生机。
之前天道化身北洛璃的话，他们都听到了。
这一战，太阳神州若是败了，仙道之力会侵蚀上苍界，届时别说他们得死，他们身后的那些道统之人，也得全部覆灭。
所以，唯有死战！
“给你们机会，看来你们不懂把握啊！
既然如此，那就手底下见真章吧。”
天剑峰主眼神凶戾，身上弥漫出一股庞大的仙道剑气。
这一次的大战，算是预热战。
但对上叶凌天等人，他们亦是不敢小觑丝毫，特意带来了永夜仙帝给的东西。
只要把东西祭出来，完全可以横扫寰宇。
若是今日这一战便可用永夜仙帝给的东西镇杀叶凌天等人，那么到时候便可直接杀到太阳神州，荡平那里。
叶凌天看向三位峰主，言语淡漠地说道：“既然是预热战，那就先让其余人切磋一下，也让我天盟之人见识一下你们仙族到底有何不凡，至于我等的交锋，倒是可以等一等。”
“理当成全！”
三位峰主闻言，没有丝毫犹豫，直接答应。

他们心中都明白，若是叶凌天和凤惑君一开始就出手，他们带来的这些仙族大军，须臾之间就会灰飞烟灭，难以起到丝毫震慑天盟众人的效果。
还不如先让仙族大军与天盟的其余人厮杀一番，好好地展露一下仙族的强大之处。
如此，才可更好震慑天盟之人。
至于叶凌天和凤惑君，这两人的实力过于可怕，他们短时间内根本拿不下，等一等再出手，倒也无妨。
“大军厮杀，亦可稍微靠后！
听闻太阳神城藏龙卧虎，有不少天之骄子，我等倒是想要先讨教一番。”
就在此时，十三道人影从战船之上飞身而出。
他们皆来自冥土和道族，此刻身上却弥漫着浓郁的仙道之力，修为也不弱，最低的都是道祖二境，更有一位道尊一境、一位道尊二境。
仙水峰主神色自傲地说道：“他们十三人，来自冥土和道族，之前不过是道主亦或者道祖之境，如今加入我古仙院，得仙道之力洗礼，修为已然暴涨，尔等若是此刻弃暗投明，亦可得仙道之力洗礼，变得更为强大。”
这十三人，是他们特意带来的，为的就是要告诉天盟之人，投靠仙族，好处多多，修为可快速提升。
“呵呵！”
叶凌天玩味一笑。
“......”
其余人也是不为所动。
之前冥土掌握邪祟之力，也可让人修为暴涨，但前提是，一辈子得听从冥土安排，但凡有丝毫想法，必死无疑。
现在这仙道之力亦是如此，一旦被侵蚀了，那就是一具行尸走肉，生死都不由自己掌握。
叶凌天道：“若愚，第一战，你先来，挑个合适的对手吧！”
“好！”
唐若愚一步踏出，冲出古城，出现在仙族大军前面三百米之地，他看向十三人之中的一位道祖四境的魁梧大汉：“你，出来一战！”
content_en:
The master of Zhenyu Peak said: "Our Ancient Immortal Academy only has enmity with Ye Lingtian and others. As long as you break away from the Heavenly Alliance, and our immortal army crosses the border in the future, you may have a chance of survival."
The Eternal Emperor said coldly: "It's extremely ridiculous!
Immortals are bloodthirsty and like to eat the flesh and blood of living beings. During the ancient battle between Immortals, many creatures in the Heaven Realm were massacred and devoured by the immortals. Do you still want to confuse the public with your lies today? "
"..."
The rest of the Tianmeng also looked at the people in the Ancient Immortal Academy with indifferent expressions. At their level, who is the fool?
They do not have the background of the Dao Clan or Netherland. If they are close to the Immortal Clan now, they will definitely end up like those creatures in the ancient Immortal Realm. They will become members of the Immortal Clan, like puppets, unable to control themselves, and eventually turn into cannon fodder, or become the blood food of the Immortal Clan.
Only by resisting to the end can they have a chance of survival.
They all heard what Bei Luoli, the incarnation of Tiandao, said before.
If the Sun State loses this battle, the power of the Immortal Dao will erode the Heaven Realm. Not only will they die, but all the Daoist people behind them will also be destroyed.
Therefore, the only option is to fight to the death!
"I've given you a chance, but it seems you don't know how to take advantage of it!
In this case, let's see the real chapter. "
The master of Tianjian Peak has fierce eyes, and a huge immortal sword energy fills his body.
This time the battle is considered a warm-up battle.
But when it came to Ye Lingtian and others, they did not dare to underestimate them in the slightest, and specially brought things given by Immortal Emperor Yongye.
As long as you sacrifice something, you can completely sweep the world.
If today's battle can be used to kill Ye Lingtian and others with the tools given by the Immortal Emperor Yong Ye, then they can go directly to the Taiyang Divine State and level it.
Ye Lingtian looked at the three peak masters and said indifferently: "Since this is a warm-up battle, let the others compete first, and let me, the people of the Tianmen League, see how extraordinary your immortal clan is. As for the confrontation between us, we can wait."
"Everything should be fulfilled!"
When the three peak masters heard this, they agreed directly without any hesitation.
They all knew in their hearts that if Ye Lingtian and Feng Huojun took action from the beginning, the army of immortals they brought would be wiped out in an instant, and would be unable to have the slightest effect on intimidating everyone in the Tianmeng.
It would be better to let the Immortal Clan army fight with the rest of the Heavenly Alliance first to fully demonstrate the power of the Immortal Clan.
Only in this way can the people of Tianmeng be better deterred.
As for Ye Lingtian and Feng Huojun, the strength of these two people is too terrifying. They can't take them down in a short time. It doesn't matter if they wait before taking action.
"When the army is fighting, you can still stay a little behind!
I heard that the City of the Sun God has hidden dragons and crouching tigers, and there are many proud men of heaven, so we wanted to ask for advice first. "
At this moment, thirteen figures flew out from the warship.
They all come from the underworld and the Tao clan. At this moment, their bodies are filled with strong power of immortality, and their cultivation levels are not weak. The lowest ones are at the second level of Dao Ancestor, and there is one Taoist first level and one Taoist second level.
Immortal Water Peak Master said with a proud look: "Thirteen of them are from the underworld and the Tao clan. They were just Tao masters or Tao ancestors before. Now they have joined our Ancient Immortal Academy and been baptized by the power of the immortal way. Their cultivation has skyrocketed. If you abandon darkness and turn to the light at this moment, you can also be baptized by the power of the immortal way and become more powerful."
These thirteen people were specially brought here in order to tell the people of the Tianmeng that joining the Immortal Clan would bring many benefits and their cultivation level could be improved quickly.
"Haha!"
Ye Lingtian smiled playfully.
"..."
The rest of the people were also unmoved.
In the past, Netherland controlled the power of evil spirits, which could also make people's cultivation skyrocket, but the premise was that they had to obey Netherland's arrangements for the rest of their lives. Anyone who had the slightest idea would definitely die.
The same is true for the power of immortality now. Once it is eroded, it will be a walking corpse, and life and death are not under its control.
Ye Lingtian said: "Ruoyu, in the first battle, you come first and challengeA suitable opponent! "
"good! "
Tang Ruoyu took one step, rushed out of the ancient city, and appeared three hundred meters in front of the immortal army. He looked at a burly man among the thirteen people who was in the fourth realm of Tao Ancestor: "You, come out and fight! "
